titulo: Independent MP Helen Haines in critical condition after ‘attack’ outside Wangaratta office, PM says
cuerpo: Anthony Albanese says his thoughts remain with Indi MP after arrest of driver at the scene on Monday afternoon Helen Haines updates: PM says person in custody after alleged attack on Helen Haines – follow live The independent MP Helen Haines has been critically injured in an alleged attack involving a vehicle outside her electorate office in Wangaratta, in regional Victoria. The prime minister, Anthony Albanese, confirmed on Monday night that a man is in custody after an alleged attack on Haines that was now being investigated by the Australian federal police (AFP), Asio and the joint counter-terror taskforce.
